features.name: Unisphere and Fountain of the Planets
features.description: The Unisphere is the clearest central landmark. Arrive via Mets-Willets Point and follow the World's Fair promenades; fountain operation is seasonal and not guaranteed.

features.name: Queens Museum and New York State Pavilion
features.description: The Queens Museum and New York State Pavilion occupy the World's Fair core. The museum is ticketed by suggested admission and the pavilion is generally viewed from outside.

features.description: Playground for All Children is an accessible family destination on the Corona side with a nearby comfort station; it is far from the tennis-center transit entrance.

features.name: Meadow Lake and boathouse
features.description: Meadow Lake and its boathouse are in the park's southern half. The lake loop is long, exposed, and separated from central attractions by highways and internal roads.

features.name: Queens Zoo
